integrity: Complete proof with a previously published orthogonal basis credited explicitly; supplementary symbolic and finite-tree calculations in checker.py are not infinite proofs. Historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns combinatorial-harmonic Bergman spaces on (q+1)-regular trees, alpha>1, bounded horocycle-dependent symbols, and inversion from horocycle-labelled eigenvalues rather than unordered spectra. No general tree or endpoint claim.
title: Horocyclic Toeplitz symbol tomography on homogeneous trees with a sharp inverse constant
